verdict.rationale: Brex publishes an Accounting API and marketing claims about automating GL coding, invoice entry and approvals, suggesting some accounting sync capability, but there is no evidence of specific integrations with major accounting platforms (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero) or confirmation of reliable automatic transaction sync. Community discussion even raises concerns about the reliability of Brex's AI-driven financial data handling, adding uncertainty to the quality of any automated sync.
